SELECT cc.id AS company_id, cc.company_name, cc.tax_number, cc.is_individual, ci.customer_name AS contact_name, ci.phone, csp.id AS profile_id, csp.bookkeeping_status, csp.filing_status, csp.star_level, csp.remark, fas.id AS account_set_id, fas.vat_type, fas.individual_tax_code FROM customer_company cc LEFT JOIN customer_info ci ON ci.id = cc.customer_id LEFT JOIN cs_customer_profile csp ON csp.company_id = cc.id AND csp.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN financial.fxy_financial_account_sets fas ON fas.credit_code = cc.tax_number WHERE cc.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND cc.deleted = 0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM contract c INNER JOIN sys_business sb ON sb.id = c.business_id AND sb.deleted = 0 AND sb.business_name IN ('代账报税-正式', '代账报税-体验') WHERE c.company_id = cc.id AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} )
AND cc.company_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.companyName}, '%')
AND ci.customer_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.contactName}, '%')
AND ci.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.phone}, '%')
ORDER BY cc.create_time DESC
